title: Camphill Communities of Ireland - Volunteer Co-Worker Programme
description: A live-in volunteer program at Camphill Communities of Ireland, a network of life-sharing communities across Ireland supporting adults and children with intellectual disabilities and additional needs. Volunteers (referred to as co-workers) live alongside residents, sharing daily life, work, and household responsibilities. In exchange, Camphill provides free accommodation, food, basic toiletries, and pocket money of EUR 50 per week (plus an additional EUR 63 per month toward holidays once the volunteer has been in the community for over three months) -- shown here as an approximate monthly equivalent of roughly EUR 217, though the amount is actually disbursed weekly. Both long-term (up to 12 months) and shorter-term volunteers are welcome; applicants are asked to commit honestly to whatever length of stay they can offer. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis rather than against a fixed deadline; interested applicants contact a community coordinator directly to begin the process.
visaNote: Non-EU/EEA volunteers will need an Irish volunteer/long-stay visa, typically arranged with the community's support.
